title: REQ-20261106-OPS002 — ATO SMSF verification service (SVS) result: GW Family Superannuation Fund — NOT VERIFIED (TFN not linked; bank & ESA mismatch)
content:
SMSF verification service (SVS) check run by Transfers & Rollovers on 6 Nov 2026 at 10:05, before any rollover to an SMSF, as required by SIS reg 6.33E. Member: Grace Williams, Caldova Super (Select) CS-1058220 (TFN held, masked *** *** 618). SMSF checked: 'GW Family Superannuation Fund', ABN 66 777 888 999. Amount requested: $612,400 (full balance).

Results:
1. ABN belongs to a registered SMSF — YES. ABN registered 28 Oct 2026; regulatory status 'Registered – status not determined', as expected for a newly established fund.
2. Member's TFN linked to the SMSF as a member — NO. Grace Williams's TFN is not recorded as a member of this SMSF.
3. TFN compromised / date of death — no date of death recorded; no identity-compromise flag on the TFN at the time of the check.
4. Bank account matches the ATO record for the SMSF — NO. The request names 'G Williams Holdings Pty Ltd' (account ending 5519); the ATO record shows a different account name and number.
5. Electronic service address (ESA) matches the ATO record — NO. Request: ROLLFASTMSG; the ATO record holds a different ESA.

Overall result: NOT VERIFIED — do not roll over. Under reg 6.33E and Caldova's rollover rules, a rollover to an SMSF cannot be paid unless SVS confirms the fund, the member's TFN link and matching bank and ESA details. The request is therefore incomplete and the 3-business-day rollover timeframe (reg 6.34A) has not started.

Risk context for Financial Crime: a newly registered SMSF (9 days old) receiving a full balance from a member whose TFN is not linked, with payment to a company account that does not match the fund name, is a listed ATO/AUSTRAC indicator of a fraudulent rollover ('creating an SMSF to receive stolen benefits'). Full SVS response attached to the case. Recommended next steps for the human team: keep the request on hold, cancel any pending SuperStream message, and consider notifying the ATO of a suspected fraudulent SMSF registration.
